title: All-team onramp: asynchronous pre-read + kickoff notes (Q1 2028) - WIP
content:
Purpose

This is the working async pre-read and live note doc for the company-wide onramp + Q1 2028 kickoff. Goal: give every team (engineering, product, SRE, GTM) a single compact view of proposed company priorities, draft OKRs, the all-team onramp run-of-show, and the comms timeline.

Context / why now
- Our growth inflection (hosted + dedicated demand) and increasing enterprise contracts mean we need tighter cross-functional coordination entering Q1 2028.
- This doc is intentionally short and practical — not the long strategy narrative. Use it for prep + rapid alignment.
- Expect 2 rounds of iteration: (1) leadership sync to refine objectives (target by 2026-09-28), (2) team-level decompositions (completed by 2026-10-12).

Top-line focus for Q1 2028 (hypothesis)
1) Predictable inference economics: reduce median per-token cost for top-10 customers by 20% via Optimize + routing improvements.
2) Enterprise-ready private: ship final Private VPC GA checklist and 2 pilot on-prem deployments.
3) Runtime reliability & SLOs: 99.95% availability on Dedicated pools + improved cold-starts.
4) Developer velocity: consolidate SDKs and reduce time-to-first-request for new customers to <10 minutes.

Draft company-level OKRs (please critique)
OKR 1: Make serving cheaper and more predictable (owner: Ethan Chen)
- O1 KR1: Reduce token cost by 20% on top-10 workloads (measured as blended unit cost)
- O1 KR2: Deploy automatic model-variant routing for 3 major customers (reduce failover latency by 50%)
- O1 KR3: Ship 2 quantized model profiles with validated quality regressions <1%

OKR 2: Private & Enterprise readiness (owner: Maya Thompson)
- O2 KR1: Complete VPC private control plane hardening + KMS integration for GA
- O2 KR2: Close 2 commercial pilot contracts for on-prem (signed MOU)
- O2 KR3: Add audit log export + retention policy to Console (30/90/365 day options)

OKR 3: Platform reliability & SLOs (owner: SRE lead TBD)
- O3 KR1: Achieve 99.95% uptime on Dedicated across primary regions
- O3 KR2: Reduce median cold-start from 450ms to 120ms for common classes
- O3 KR3: Implement canary rollback automation with a <15 min median recovery time

OKR 4: Developer experience (owner: DevEx lead)
- O4 KR1: Combine JavaScript + Python SDKs into single mono-repo and cut install/config steps by 40%
- O4 KR2: Publish 8 reference apps (PLG templates) and measure activation funnel lift +15%

Notes to reviewers (shorthand)
- These are intentionally tight — owners will add team-level KRs that ladder up.
- We need concrete definitions for measurement: what counts as "top-10 customers"? Finance to propose list and weighting (action: Priya).
- Potential conflicts: optimizing per-token cost might increase latency or quality regression risk. We'll need a cross-functional risk board (ops + research + product).

All-hands / onramp run-of-show (asynchronous-first design)
- Pre-read (this doc) — distributed 7 days before sync
- 30-minute recorded exec update (founders + head of product) — published 48 hours before live Q&A
- Live 60-minute town (focus on: priorities, big bets, support ask) — recorded for those async
- Breakouts: 3x 25 minute thematic rooms (optimize, private, reliability) with T-conductors and action capture
- Office hours week after for deep dives and team planning

Draft all-hands agenda (60m):
- 00:00–05:00 Opening: context + company pulse (CEO)
- 05:00–20:00 Product strategy highlight: top 3 bets (Head Product)
- 20:00–35:00 Engineering highlight: reliability + cost wins (Eng lead)
- 35:00–45:00 Customer spotlight: pilot story + ask to product/ops (CS)
- 45:00–55:00 What success looks like + commitments (Leads)
- 55:00–60:00 Live Qs + where to file follow-ups (async threads encouraged)

Comms & timeline (proposed)
- D-14: Leadership review + iterate doc (this doc)
- D-10: Exec recording due; comms team drafts announcement
- D-7: Pre-read distributed & Slack AMA thread opened
- D-3: Breakout leader prep & materials due
- Day: Live all-hands + breakout rooms
- Week +1: Office hours + team-level OKR decompositions due

Open decisions / unresolved questions
- Measurement definition for cost KRs (Priya + Finance) — waiting on customer list and current usage baselines (JIRA: PLAN-3421).
- Final SRE owner for platform-slos OKR (ask: SRE manager to confirm by 09/24).
- Comms cadence: do we want a single 2-page one-pager (exec) + FAQ or a 6-slide deck + FAQ? (Prefer deck + short one-pager).

Action items (short list)
- Priya: pull top-10 customer usage baseline (due 2026-09-18)
- Ethan: refine cost-reduction tactics doc (autoscaling, batching, quant profiles) and link to experiment plan (due 2026-09-22)
- Maya: finalize Private GA checklist + security gating items (due 2026-09-24)
- Comms (Sofia): draft announcement + pre-read distribution plan (due 2026-09-25)

Risks & mitigation (brief)
- Risk: quality regressions from aggressive quantization -> Mitigation: gated A/B + explicit evals on production prompts.
- Risk: support load spike after GA -> Mitigation: rotate escalation + hotline + prepared runbooks.
- Risk: mixed messages across leadership -> Mitigation: single pre-recorded exec track and central FAQ doc to align.

Notes to self / editorial TODOs
- Convert this doc into the short one-pager + bulletized FAQ for the internal site.
- Run a 30-minute dry run with breakout leads 48 hours prior.
- Update linked JIRA + confluence ids once finalized.

Quick references (where to add comments)
- Add inline comments to this doc for suggested wording changes.
- Use Slack thread #company-onramp for quick calls.

Appendix (scratch ideas for comms hooks)
- "Predictable inference economics" one-liner: "Same model, predictable cost — tools that make serving predictable for product teams."
- Customer spotlight: highlight a pilot who used Dedicated + Optimize to reduce query cost by X%. (Need marketing approval).

End — please leave feedback inline and tag owners for action.
